title: Checkout time to interactive
summary: Make the checkout page usable sooner on a mid-range phone over 4G, without losing completed checkouts. (Example data.)
verdict: About a fifth of the way short: 1,840 ms against 1,500 on the mid-range phone, and parse and hydration on the low-end phone are now the biggest stages.

metrics.name: Time to interactive, p75
metrics.how: Lab runner, mid-range phone profile on 4G, 30 runs on each of the 6 dev pages; p75 of all runs. CI by bootstrap.
metrics.finding: Down 570 ms from the baseline, 340 ms still to go; the last three kept changes each gave 50–160 ms.

metrics.name: JavaScript shipped
metrics.how: Compressed JS on the checkout route, from the build's stats file.
metrics.finding: Code-splitting took the big cut; the date library (E7) is parked until JS is the limit.

metrics.name: Checkout completed in replays
metrics.how: 500 recorded checkout sessions replayed against the build; share that reach the receipt.
metrics.against: 500 recorded sessions replayed against the build, not live traffic
metrics.finding: Holding at 96 % except E6, which broke address autocomplete.

splits.what: 4 other checkout pages (other countries' forms), never tuned on

breakdowns.title: Where the time goes
breakdowns.finding: Server render and JS download shrank most; on the low-end phone, parse and hydration now cost 1,150 ms of 2,680.
breakdowns.note: p75 per stage from the lab runner's traces, on the current build (E5). The ghost is each stage at the baseline (E0).

parts.label: Third-party tags

revisions.what: TTI is scored at p75 of all runs, not the median.
revisions.why: The median hid the slow third of runs, where most abandoned checkouts are. Old and new numbers for E0–E3 are in R2.
